name: Keiko-chan no Himitsu
source:
Your tutor Keiko disappeared from the room. You need to find her  to continue love lessons.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]

你的家教慶子從房間裡消失了。為了繼續愛的課程，你必須把她找出來。
